name: iPhone location changer comparison
made_by: Roam (roamlocation.com), one of the tools listed

tools.name: Roam
tools.supported_ios: iOS 27 or newer; Developer Mode must be on
tools.pricing_model: fixed-length pass (1, 7, 30 or 365 days), one iPhone per pass
tools.refund_policy_summary: Money back only if Roam doesn't work on your iPhone and you ask within 7 days of paying.
tools.notes: Not on the App Store; installed from a personal link tied to the iPhone. A restart restores the real location. Listed by the dataset maintainer (see README disclosure).

tools.name: Geovo
tools.supported_ios: iOS 17.4 or later (iPhone XS/XR and newer), iPad; macOS 13+, Windows 10/11
tools.refund_policy_summary: Page states: refund if it can't work on your iPhone (within 14 days, with support); also: refunds if you haven't used Geovo since buying. See their Refund Policy.
tools.notes: Setup from a Mac or Windows PC with a cable; the iPhone app then continues on Wi-Fi or cellular and is renewed from the computer every 7 days, or automatically. One 15-minute account trial per their FAQ. Pro covers 2 computers and 2 iPhones.

tools.name: GFaker
tools.supported_ios: Homepage: iOS 9 to iOS 27. GF II product page: iOS 9 through iOS 26.6.2. The pages disagree.
tools.cheapest_paid_option: 469.00 (GF II page range 469.00-479.00; no separate price per model in page text)
tools.refund_policy_summary: Seven-day no-reason return, per their FAQ.
tools.notes: Single-spot and multi-spot movement with a set speed. Vendor pages blocked automated re-fetch on 2026-11-16; values are as recorded from their pages on roamlocation.com/guides/roam-vs-gfaker the same day.

tools.name: Mirage
tools.needs_computer: no on iOS 27; one-time computer step on iOS 18-26
tools.pricing_model: no paid plan listed; README says it is free and optional sponsorship unlocks nothing
tools.notes: Invite-only access per README. Installed by sideloading (SideStore/AltStore or a signed build).

tools.name: Locus
tools.needs_computer: no on iOS 27; pairing file from a computer once on iOS 18-26
tools.supported_ios: iOS 27 with on-device pairing; iOS 18-26 with an RPPairing file
tools.works_on_mobile_data: yes (start on Wi-Fi first, then the session can continue on cellular)
tools.pricing_model: no paid plan listed; README says free and open source (MIT)
tools.notes: Also requires the LocalDevVPN app. Prebuilt IPA or build from source.

tools.name: Roam Control
tools.notes: Separate project; not Roam and not made or sold by BLOCC. README describes on-device pairing and installation via SideStore or LiveContainer; whether a computer is needed is not stated. Price not stated.

tools.name: Tenorshare iAnyGo
tools.product_type: Windows/Mac program + iOS and Android apps
tools.needs_computer: partial: steps start on the computer; page says no computer required after installation
tools.supported_ios: Product page: iOS 14 - iOS 27 or later. 1-device buy plans: iOS 14 to iOS 26 or later, excluding iOS 17.0 and 17.1.
tools.cheapest_paid_option: 14.99 per month (iOS app, 1 device, tax excl.)
tools.refund_policy_summary: 30-day money-back guarantee if there is no solution after they analyse the problem; see their refund policy.
tools.notes: Product page offers trying it for 1 hour. Desktop plans are priced separately.

tools.name: iMyFone AnyTo
tools.product_type: Windows/Mac program + iOS and Android apps
tools.needs_computer: partial: iPhone steps get the app through the desktop program; page also says it can be used without a PC
tools.supported_ios: iOS 5 and up (iOS 27 included); Windows 7-11, macOS 10.9-14
tools.cheapest_paid_option: from 14.99 (product page); purchase-page plan amounts not in page text
tools.refund_policy_summary: Cancel anytime; 30-day money back guarantee if they cannot help solve the technical problem.

tools.name: iToolab AnyGo
tools.product_type: Windows/Mac program + iOS and Android apps
tools.needs_computer: yes for desktop steps; an iOS app is sold separately
tools.cheapest_paid_option: 9.95 per month (desktop, shown beside 19.95); iOS app 19.95 per month
tools.refund_policy_summary: 30-day money-back guarantee; whole-order refunds within the guarantee period, no partial OS refunds.
tools.notes: iOS buy page: 1 month 19.95, quarter 39.95, year 79.95 (tax excl.), 5 iOS devices, Windows and Mac included.

tools.name: Dr.Fone Virtual Location
tools.supported_ios: Product page: iOS 5.0 and later, compatible with iOS 27. Buy-page plans: iOS 26.
tools.cheapest_paid_option: 4.97 per month (monthly plan, shown beside 14.95 under a 66% off banner)
tools.refund_policy_summary: Up to a 7-day money-back guarantee, under the circumstances they accept.
tools.notes: iPhone connects by USB, or by Wi-Fi after one earlier connection. 2-hour trial per buy page.

tools.name: 3uTools (Virtual Location)
tools.cheapest_paid_option: not listed on the pages checked
tools.notes: Tutorial: open the PC client, connect via USB cable, Toolbox > Virtual Location, set one modified location.
